title: My Block is a real street now
excerpt: Finished neighborhoods now appear as scrollable streets, alongside fixes for the Claw prize label and Team race banner.
body: My Block now presents finished neighborhoods as scrollable streets, with house names on the road. Each property shows its real construction stage as you move along the block.
The Claw prize label no longer overlaps the house pile.
The Team race banner no longer cuts off its second line.
